formal_baseline: original LLaDA low-confidence, 128 steps, generation length 256, block length 32

method.horizontal: Generate the fixed-budget symmetric_fast trajectory and the conservative accuracy-first symmetric trajectory; tokens on which they agree form a shared full-draft skeleton.
method.vertical: Re-mask every generated position on which the two final trajectories disagree, run one normal model forward from that identical counterfactual context, and compare the mean log-probability of each trajectory's alternative tokens only at those positions.
method.selection: Choose the trajectory with higher common-context disagreement score; ties preserve symmetric_fast.
method.extra_nfe: one when trajectories disagree, zero when identical

development.human_eval: HumanEval/0-31; score gate only, already considered development in earlier work
development.gate: method > symmetric_fast, method >= original LLaDA, and at least one method-only recovery

formal_unseen.note: No correctness labels, candidate outputs, selector scores, or task-specific features from this range were inspected before registration.
formal_unseen.gate: method > symmetric_fast, method > original LLaDA, and at least one method-only recovery

promotion.math500: paired first 50, Prism-aligned evaluator; require no loss against both comparators
promotion.later: only after MATH non-loss, sample MBPP-50 and GSM8K-64

diagnostic_fix: Commit 6ff8285 preserves full HumanEval candidate trace text; frozen v3 candidate-text oracle artifacts are explicitly invalid and not used for this rule.
